Custom user-agent string is applied for single domain crawl

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const crawlberg = @import("crawlberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try crawlberg.crawl("{\"max_depth\":0,\"stay_on_domain\":true,\"user_agents\":[\"Mozilla/5.0 TestBot/1.0 (+http://example.com/bot)\"]}", "https://example.com");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
